name: flash_fastprogram
description: FLASH_FastProgram: bank 2 mass-erased (MER2, 22.13 ms), then programmed a 256-byte row at a time (FSTPG, 1024 x 1.91 ms, DS12288's fast row) by a program running from bank 1, which goes on meanwhile and polls BSY: about 2 s before LD2 comes on once every word reads back.
